observations: body (Antares, Naṣīr ad-dīn): the parenthesis «(cod. انطرنس)» and the note sign «(3)» belong after «انطريس» and after «المرِّيخ» in the reading of the two Arabic phrases and stand at their left ends, as printed; the vowel signs of «خِلْقَة» and «المرِّيخ» (with the shadda) are printed.

body (Arabic): «الخوصى» is printed with the final yāʾ without dots in the lines of Naṣīr ad-dīn and aṣ-Ṣūfī, «الخوصي» with them in notes 2 and 5; «التوأم» (Naṣīr ad-dīn) with the hamza on alif, «توءم», «التوءم» (Ulugh Beg) with the hamza on the line; in «تالى», «است», «شمعي» the dots are printed merged into short strokes.

body (Antares, versio Musaei Britannici): «الكوكب» is printed with a long joining stroke (kashīda), not transcribed; «قاب» is printed so (for «قلب», as in the line of Naṣīr ad-dīn): the bāʾ stands apart from the alif.
notes_left L12, L15: «principal» (L12) is printed with the n broken into two strokes; «tho» (L15) is printed so (for «to»).
notes_right L1: «خلڡه المرح» is printed without the dots of qāf and of khāʾ and without yāʾ (the reading of the codex).
notes_right L4: the abbreviation of the 1515 edition is printed as a q joined to an r rotunda; transcribed «qꝛ».
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
